# Air

Air is a flat, ultra-dark theme built on a single near-black surface, with minimal chrome, padded headings and square corners throughout. It extends the accent colour chosen in Obsidian to headings, bold and italic text, highlights, tags, checkboxes and bullets, while primary text stays near-white and muted content steps through greys. The ribbon stays hidden until hover, and both dark and light modes are supported.

![Air screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/punkyard/obsidian-theme-air/HEAD/assets/hero.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Air"
    author: "punkyard"
    repo:   "punkyard/obsidian-theme-air"
    slug:   "air"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/air"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/punkyard/obsidian-theme-air"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/punkyard/obsidian-theme-air/HEAD/assets/hero.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a flat, ultra-dark interface with a uniform #0A0A0A surface, minimal chrome, padded headings, and zero border-radius. Extend your chosen accent color to headings, bold and italic text, highlights, tags, checkboxes, and bullets while keeping near-white primary text, stepped grays for muted content, a ribbon that hides until hover, and support for dark and light modes."
}
```
